fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner to ask. The change set's intent: a plan run captures the interview's picks and answers as Decisions when the interview step says done, not only when its session exits. Code read: session done (internal/api/session_done.go) writes only the done mark; answers are captured only on exit (captureAfterRun in internal/api/session_run.go) and by session interview; captureInterview skips handles already proposed, so a second capture adds nothing. Token use already reads the transcript at done (recordTokenUse), the precedent for capturing there. Choices settled here, each marked as assumed in its Decision's wording: capture at done before the done mark is written, so a step waiting on done sees the Decisions; a capture failure is a warning and the mark stands; session done reports the Decisions it proposed.
fields.title: Plan captures on done: autonomous planning of the change set

fields.statement: Answers are proposed as Decisions when the session says done, before the done mark is written, and again when its agent exits; the handle skip keeps a repeat capture from adding twice
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated): capture at done, as the change set's intent says, and before the mark, so a step waiting on done finds the Decisions

fields.statement: A capture that fails when the session says done is a warning in the response; the done mark stands
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated): follows the token-use precedent, where a failed read at done is a warning

fields.statement: rhiza session done --json lists the handles of the Decisions it proposed under decisions, as rhiza session run --json does
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated): matches the response of session run

fields.acceptance: A testscript whose fake agent leaves a transcript with one picked and one typed answer and says done: the change set holds both answer Decisions when session done returns, a second session done proposes nothing, a later session run exit adds nothing already proposed, and a session with no transcript says done with a warning and keeps its mark. A Go test with a capture hook shows the done mark is not yet set when the capture runs
fields.statement: rhiza session done proposes the session's answered questions as Decisions before it writes the done mark, so a step that waits on done finds them; a dry run captures nothing, and a capture that fails is a warning while the mark stands

ops.note: adds a capture at done; the capture on exit stays

fields.acceptance: The done testscript's --json output lists both answer handles under decisions, and describe-golden is regenerated for the new response field
fields.statement: rhiza session done --json lists the handles of the Decisions it proposed under decisions, so the planner and the run see what was captured
